title: The real $K$-theory of the sphere with an arbitrary involution
summary: We complete the investigation begun in a previous paper to find unitary representations of the non-trivial real $K$-theory elements for the sphere $S^d$ with an involution. Here we consider all involutions except the antipodal involutions. We write down explicit unitaries representing the generators in all cases for $d \leq 3$, and for $d > 0$ we describe a recipe for generating such unitaries.
